content.user_title: Create Slack-Ready GIFs and Emoji Animations
content.value_statement: Slack GIFs need tight size, frame, and dimension limits. This skill provides Python helpers that build, optimize, and validate animations for Slack use.
actual_capabilities: Build animated GIFs from generated frames with a reusable GIFBuilder helper.
Validate Slack emoji and message GIF size, dimensions, frame count, and duration.
Create motion effects such as shake, bounce, spin, pulse, fade, zoom, slide, flip, and morph.
Draw emojis, text, shapes, gradients, shadows, particles, flashes, and shockwave effects.
Reduce file size through color quantization, duplicate frame removal, resizing, and frame reduction.
Compose custom animations from reusable Python primitives and example patterns.
limitations: Requires Python and image libraries such as Pillow, imageio, and numpy.
Does not upload GIFs to Slack or manage Slack workspace settings.
Emoji rendering depends on available system fonts and may vary by operating system.
Very complex emoji animations may still need manual simplification to meet the 64 KB limit.

use_cases.title: Create custom reaction emoji
use_cases.description: Build small animated emoji reactions that fit Slack upload limits.

use_cases.title: Prepare launch announcement GIFs
use_cases.description: Create short message GIFs with motion, text, and effects for Slack announcements.

use_cases.title: Prototype animation concepts
use_cases.description: Combine reusable motion primitives to test GIF ideas before polishing assets.

prompt_templates.title: Make a simple emoji GIF
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner request for a small Slack emoji animation.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a 128x128 Slack emoji GIF of a party emoji pulsing for two seconds. Keep it under 64 KB and validate the result.

prompt_templates.title: Build a message reaction GIF
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate request for a larger Slack message animation.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a 480x480 Slack message GIF where a rocket slides in, bounces, and reveals short celebration text. Optimize it under 2 MB.

prompt_templates.title: Combine multiple effects
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced request that mixes primitives and validation.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a Slack GIF using move, shake, flash, and text outline effects. Explain the frame plan, then save and validate the output.

prompt_templates.title: Refine an oversized GIF
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced troubleshooting for Slack upload constraints.
prompt_templates.prompt: Analyze why my generated Slack emoji GIF is too large. Reduce frames, colors, and dimensions while preserving the main motion.

output_examples.input: Make a Slack emoji where a warning symbol pulses twice and stays readable.
output_examples.output: A compact 128x128 animated emoji with a pulsing warning symbol, simplified colors, and validation feedback for the Slack size limit.

output_examples.input: Create a launch GIF with a rocket, impact flash, and GOAL text for a Slack message.
output_examples.output: A short message GIF concept with phased motion, outlined text, color optimization, and a final size check for Slack message use.

output_examples.input: My emoji GIF is over 64 KB. Make it smaller without losing the core idea.
output_examples.output: An optimization plan that reduces frames, color count, gradients, and visual complexity, followed by a refreshed validation result.

best_practices: Validate file size early and again after every major animation change.
Use fewer frames, simple shapes, and limited colors for Slack emoji GIFs.
Plan animations in short phases before combining motion primitives and effects.
anti_patterns: Do not use complex gradients or many particles in 64 KB emoji GIFs.
Do not assume system emoji fonts render the same on every machine.
Do not run dependency installation commands without explicit user approval.

faq.question: Can this skill create Slack emoji GIFs under 64 KB?
faq.answer: Yes, it includes emoji optimization and validators. Complex animations may still need manual simplification.

faq.question: Can it create larger GIFs for Slack messages?
faq.answer: Yes, it supports 480x480 message GIFs and checks the approximate 2 MB size target.

faq.question: Does it upload GIFs directly to Slack?
faq.answer: No. It creates and validates GIF files, but Slack upload is a separate manual step.

faq.question: What animation effects are included?
faq.answer: It includes shake, bounce, spin, pulse, fade, zoom, explode, wiggle, slide, flip, morph, move, and kaleidoscope helpers.

faq.question: What dependencies are needed?
faq.answer: The toolkit uses Python image libraries, including Pillow, imageio, imageio-ffmpeg, and numpy.

faq.question: Can I customize the generated animation?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill is built around reusable primitives that can be combined or replaced for custom designs.
